newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Aznar's Argentine visit to focus on trade, politics.
newsitem.headline: Aznar's Argentine visit to focus on trade, politics.

text.p: Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar arrives in Argentina Saturday for a three-day visit expected to focus on boosting ties between the European Union and the Mercosur customs union.
"President (Carlos) Menem and I will review all aspects of relations between Spain and Argentina, the Mercosur and Europe," Aznar said, according to Argentina's state news agency Telam.

A series of European leaders and trade delegations have visited the customs union of Uruguay, Paraguay, Brazil and Argentina recently, wanting to take advantage of the growing markets and increasing trade in the region.
Aznar, who will be accompanied by a delegation of businessmen and two government ministers, will start his official business Sunday, an official at Spain's Embassy said.
Aznar told businessmen in Brazil Wednesday that stronger ties between Europe and Ibero-America were now a cornerstone of Spanish policy, and Spain could play a bridge-building role.
Argentina's Menem is likely to back Aznar's suggestion of a summit between Ibero-American and EU heads of state in 1999.

Business issues likely to be on the agenda include the proposed sale by Spanish flag carrier Iberia of a stake in Aerolineas Argentinas. American Airlines and Continental Airlines have both shown interest in Aerolineas.

The two leaders are also likely to discuss this week's announcement by British Telecommunications Plc and MCI that Telefonica de Espana SA has joined the two firms' Concert alliance to pursue the Latin American communications market.
Menem and Aznar could also touch on more sensitive topics, such as a probe into the disappearance of 300 Spaniards in Argentina's "Dirty War" in the 1970s.

A Spanish court has charged former military ruler Gen. Leopoldo Galtieri with ordering the killings of three of the Spaniards. It demanded Galtieri's extradition to Spain to be tried. Argentina rejected the demand.
